# Zero UIV Modern Expansion Panel

A highly customizable, Uiverse-inspired Modern accordion component for Lit.

## Features

- ✅ Smooth height transition animations
- ✅ Clean shadow elevation on expansion
- ✅ Chevron rotation indicator
- ✅ Slot support for flexible content
- ✅ Pure CSS (No Tailwind)
- ✅ Fully customizable via RendererAttributes (Title, Accent Color)
- ✅ ADA Compliant

## Installation

```html
<script src="path/to/zero-uiv-expansion-modern.js" type="module"></script>
```

## Usage

```html
<zero-uiv-expansion-modern title="User Profile">
    <p>Details about the user go here...</p>
</zero-uiv-expansion-modern>
```

## CSS Variables

- `--uiv-expansion-bg`: Background color
- `--uiv-expansion-text`: Title text color
- `--uiv-expansion-accent`: Chevron and focus color
